computer scroll: scroll at X Y

Usage: computer [-c NAME] scroll X Y up|down|left|right [N]

Moves the mouse to X Y and scrolls N notches (default 3) in a direction.

Arguments:
  X          integer     required  horizontal pixel position, 0 = left edge
  Y          integer     required  vertical pixel position, 0 = top edge
  DIRECTION  enum        required  scroll direction (up, down, left, right)
  N          integer     optional  number of notches; default 3

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  computer scroll 640 400 down 5

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen remote (-c NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the computer
